alex-pm: Quick kickoff for new model partner (AuroraEcho). They want: hosted marketplace SKU, SI bundle with CloudReseller, and clear redistribution terms. Need KMS for private deploys and an embargo for joint PR.
linda-legal: On it. Ask for a redistribution addendum that specifies hosted listing allowed, SI resale opt-in, and export control provenance. I can draft a short addendum.
tess-marketing: Timeline? We need logos, boileplate, and a co-branded one-pager. Proposed embargo 2025-12-01.
omar-eng: Artifacts: FP16 weights + quantized INT8 for edge. We'll expose two SKUs. For perf testing we need artifact upload to staging.
kevin-infra: KMS plan: Hosted uses our KMS; Dedicated supports tenant-managed HSM; Private requires customer KMS in VPC. Also will implement wipe-on-delete for weights per supplier request. Need signed URL TTL and ACL details from supplier.
announce-bot: Reminder: fill marketplace metadata form: https://marketplace.redwood/new-sku due 2025-11-20
alex-pm: Owners: Legal=linda-legal, Infra=kevin-infra, Marketing=tess-marketing, Eng=omar-eng, Sales/SI=marco-sales. Any blockers?
linda-legal: Waiting on supplier signature and provenance attestation.
kevin-infra: Need staging upload + KMS test by Thu to hit timeline.
omb: noted (typo)
tess-marketing: I'll chase assets and draft press copy.
alex-pm: OK locking this plan. I'll post a checklist in tracker. :white_check_mark:
